# `prefer-string-switch`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: idiomatic · Default: off · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports three or more adjacent-style `std.mem.eql` string comparisons that map
the same subject to simple values.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

`std.meta.stringToEnum` or `std.StaticStringMap` exposes the closed dispatch set
and avoids repeated scans.

## When it fires

Comparisons must use `u8`, distinct string literals, one stable subject, and
simple value arms. Branches containing statement blocks remain explicit.
Choosing the mapped value type is design work, so no automatic edit is offered.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
const std = @import("std");

const Command = enum { start, stop, status, unknown };

fn parse(cmd: []const u8) Command {
    return if (std.mem.eql(u8, cmd, "start")) .start
    else if (std.mem.eql(u8, cmd, "stop")) .stop
    else if (std.mem.eql(u8, cmd, "status")) .status
    else .unknown;
}
```
